subject: Intro call: clarify use case, peak tokens/day and pilot timeline
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@leda-commerce.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a quick demo — Leda Commerce

Hi Mina,

I signed up through the self-serve flow this morning and wanted to request a short demo to see how Redwood could fit into our roadmap. High level: we run search + recommendations on product pages and want to experiment with a reranking + natural-language summary layer for long user queries.

Quick context/questions up front so we can land on the right demo:
- Current traffic: ~50k organic product searches/day; expected pilot traffic ~10k requests/day with average 300 tokens/request (so roughly 3M tokens/day during pilot). Peak sales days could spike to ~1M tokens/day for short windows.
- Timeline: aiming for a 6–8 week pilot starting mid-July if the demo checks out.
- Integrations: we have a Next.js storefront and an AWS-hosted catalog; interested in embeddings + a lightweight rerank pipeline.

Can we schedule a 30 min call this week to walk through fit? My availability: Wed/Thu mornings PST.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Search Engineering
Leda Commerce
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@leda-commerce.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — Leda Commerce

Hi Samir — great to meet you (and thanks for signing up). I can definitely set up a focused 30 min walk-through and flag the parts that map to a pilot. A couple quick clarifying questions so I tailor the call:

- Use case detail: is the goal primarily reranking (+embedding search), or is the NL summary layer the main value prop you want to test first?
- Volume detail: you mentioned ~3M tokens/day for pilot — is that the steady-state expectation, or is that a 24h average including spikes? What concurrency (requests/sec) does 10k req/day map to during peak?
- Data sensitivity: any PII in queries or responses? Do you need VPC/Private deployment or would hosted be OK for pilot?
- Auth & SSO: do you require SAML/SSO for the demo environment?
- Integration preference: do you want a code-first walkthrough (SDK + snippets) or product/console focus?

Proposed 3 slots (all PST):
- Wed Jun 9, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jun 9, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Jun 10, 09:30–10:00

Pick whichever works and I’ll send a calendar invite. Also looping in Ben Carter (cc) — he’ll join to cover pilot pricing/commit options if we progress.

Best,
Mina Haddad
SDR, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0114
From: Samir Khan <samir.k@leda-commerce.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — Leda Commerce

Thanks Mina — Wed Jun 9 at 10:00 PST works for me.

Answers inline:
- Priority: reranking + embeddings first (we think the summary layer will come later). Want to see a drop-in approach to rerank vs rebuilding our current pipeline.
- Volume: the ~3M tokens/day number was an estimate for an active pilot week (steady-state pilot might be closer to 1.2M tokens/day). Peak windows during promotions could approach ~1M tokens over 2–3 hours (so bursts, not constant). Concurrency: expect ~20–60 concurrent small requests during peaks; average QPS ~5.
- PII: minimal — mostly product names and user search strings; no payment data in requests.
- Deployment: hosted is fine for the pilot (we can discuss Private for production later).
- Auth: SSO not required for the demo, but we will need SAML for production.
- Integration: code-first preferred — show SDK snippets for the rerank flow and embedding ingestion.

Attaching a tiny sample of traffic (anonymized) to give you a sense of queries.

See you Wed at 10:00 PST.

—Samir
(attachment: sample_traffic.csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.k@leda-commerce.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call: clarify use case, peak tokens/day and pilot timeline

Hi Samir — Ben here from Redwood’s sales team. Thanks for the details and for confirming Wed 10:00 PST — calendar invite sent (link: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/mina/30m).

A few quick next steps so we start the pilot plan on the call:
- Mina will do a product + code walkthrough focused on embedding + rerank.
- I’ll cover pilot sizing, cost estimates, and a simple mutual action plan: scope, success metrics, duration (we typically run a 6–8 week pilot and track throughput/cost/regression on a small eval set).
- Please have one engineer from your side join who can speak to ingestion (we’ll review the CSV you attached).

If you want any pre-read, I can send our pilot checklist and a short note on batching/quantization knobs that matter for rerank workloads. Do you want those ahead of Wed?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
